title: Algorithmic universal étale $(\varphi,Γ)$-modules
summary: Let $F/\mathbb{Q}_p$ be a finite extension and let $\breve{G}$ be a connected reductive group with connected center satisfying $p>h_{\breve{G}}$ (the Coxeter number). We write down explicit polynomial equations for the reduced Emerton-Gee stacks (the Borel and the twisted Borel versions that jointly cover the entire $\mathcal{X}_{\breve{G},\mathrm{red}}^{\mathrm{EG}}$), by introducing the mod $p$ Weil-Deligne stacks capturing derived structures of $(\varphi, Γ)$-modules in reduced families.
